name: Prism
author: Erin Carter
description: A solid of clear glass — an octahedron you see straight through, the palette environment bending and splitting into spectral colour as it refracts twice through the stone, with a bright fresnel rim where the surface turns away.

params.label: Index
params.effect: Refractive strength — how hard the glass bends what is behind it, from near-water to dense crystal.

params.label: Dispersion
params.effect: How far the colours split as they pass through, from colourless glass to a full prism rainbow.

params.label: Clarity
params.effect: Clear versus tinted body; low gives the glass a palette-coloured stain, high keeps it transparent.

params.label: Mouse influence
params.effect: How strongly the pointer parallaxes the camera around the glass; 0 ignores the mouse.
